purpose: Define a read-only Expose monitor/editor projection for datasets, catalog entries, annotations, ownership/steward refs, search metadata, classification summaries and registration state.

owns: DWH Catalog and Metadata Monitor semantics

topics.name: DWH Catalog and Metadata Monitor
topics.purpose: Define a read-only Expose monitor/editor projection for datasets, catalog entries, annotations, ownership/steward refs, search metadata, classification summaries and registration state.

semantics.identity_rule: Dataset, catalog entry, annotation, schema/resource and search-result identities remain distinct.
semantics.authority_rule: Viewing or discovering resources grants no underlying data authority.
semantics.action_rule: register/edit-metadata/deprecate/reconcile/reclassify operations invoke separate authorized canonical workflows.
semantics.derived_rule: Ranking, summaries and metadata projections are displayed as derived/descriptive evidence.
semantics.graph_rule: Catalog→resource→schema/lineage edges correspond only to explicit refs.
semantics.failure_rule: Duplicate entries, stale annotations, ownership mismatches and classification conflicts are surfaced explicitly.

invariants.rule: Catalog and metadata records describe exact DWH resources and evidence; discovery, labels, annotations, ranking or catalog visibility never replace canonical resource identity, semantic ownership, classification policy or authorization.

hard_gates.condition: monitor conflates catalog entry and dataset identity
search rank displayed as semantic priority
monitor directly declassifies via tag edit

references.purpose: Monitor exposes classification metadata as projection only.
